findings.message: FC-02: Time-sensitive: the trial is ongoing as of 13 October 2026. When a verdict comes, the opening, the close, the end card and the description are out of date.
findings.fix: Publish only while the trial is ongoing, or make a new versioned cut with the verdict, attributed to reporting, and re-run the gate.

findings.message: C01: conflicting accounts recorded: C01: Address: Duke Chronicle gives 5639 Old Chapel Hill Road; ABC11 places unit 1502 'at the View on Old Durham Road' (Q3). One WRAL summary calls it 'a friend's apartment near the Durham-Chapel Hill border' (Q11) while most call it her apartment. — Handling: Script says 'an off-campus apartment in Chapel Hill'; no address.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C02: conflicting accounts recorded: C02: Sophomore (AP, N&O, WRAL 2021) vs junior (Wikipedia). A podcast says she was weeks from turning 20 (Q34) - not corroborated. — Handling: Script says she was 19; no class year.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C03: conflicting accounts recorded: C03: Hometown: Hollister (WUNC) vs Warrenton (Daily Tar Heel). — Handling: Script says Warren County; no town.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C09: conflicting accounts recorded: C09: 4:27 a.m. (police/WRAL) vs 4:25 a.m. (UNC Media Hub); 911 call logged 11:01 a.m. per Media Hub. — Handling: Script gives 'about 4:30' and 'around 11' as police said.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C11: conflicting accounts recorded: C11: One summary (Q40) calls Rangel a 'Roommate'; most coverage calls her a friend of both women. — Handling: Script says 'with a friend'.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C14: conflicting accounts recorded: C14: Rum bottle (trial coverage, CBS17, DTH) vs 'wine bottle' (ABC11 warrant story, Fox genealogy line Q60). Treat 'rum bottle' as the State's description at trial. — Handling: Script says 'a bottle, prosecutors say'; neither rum nor wine is asserted as fact.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C16: conflicting accounts recorded: C16: Contrasts with the State's 2026 theory that the killer was a stranger (C43). This is a narrative tension, not a contradiction of the evidence. — Handling: Script sets the 2012 'not random' statement against the State's 2026 'stranger' theory, both attributed.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C17: conflicting accounts recorded: C17: 9th Street Journal says 'knew'; WRAL says 'might have been familiar'. Use the hedged wording. — Handling: Script attributes the 2013 profile to police and the FBI.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C24: conflicting accounts recorded: C24: Who ran the genealogy work is not public. The jury will not hear IGG evidence (C36). — Handling: Script says investigators say genealogy led to him, and that the jury will not hear that evidence.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C30: conflicting accounts recorded: C30: AP's trial-opening story lists murder, rape and burglary only, omitting the sexual offense count (Q26). — Handling: Script lists the four charges in the indictment as amended in 2024 (most outlets).
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C32: conflicting accounts recorded: C32: Plea date: early Aug 2026 (DTH, Tar Heel Times 8/4/2026) vs Nov 2024 (East Idaho News; possibly an earlier arraignment). — Handling: Script says he has pleaded not guilty; no plea date.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C40: conflicting accounts recorded: C40: Some reports call 7 Oct the start of the trial; others count from jury selection on 28 Sept, which explains 'second week' (ABC) vs 'third week' (WRAL). — Handling: Script gives the jury-selection start date and 12 + 4; no week count.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C43: conflicting accounts recorded: C43: Contrasts with the 2012-2013 police view (C16, C17) and with the defence's consent theory (C45). — Handling: Script gives the State's 'stranger' theory as the prosecutor's words, alongside the 2012 police statement and the defence's answer.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: C46: conflicting accounts recorded: C46: Defence suggestion they may have known each other (C45). — Handling: Script gives the family's statement; the defence's contrary suggestion (single source) is not used.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: H-ONTRIAL: conflicting accounts recorded: C41: Week count: 'second week' (ABC, Fox) vs 'third week' (WRAL) vs 'fifth day of testimony' (CBS17). — Handling: Script says he has pleaded not guilty and the trial is ongoing as of 13 October 2026.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: H-NOTE: conflicting accounts recorded: C15: The wording 'jk' given in the research brief could NOT be verified: 'None of the results contain "jk,"' (Q36). Every source renders the second line as 'Jealous'. Profanity is rendered variously. — Handling: Script quotes only 'I'm not stupid' and 'Jealous'; the expletive is not spoken or shown.
findings.fix: Re-check the handling note if the script changes.

findings.message: FC-01: Every source was read as search-result text; three page fetches failed. Several ABC11 and WRAL summaries were filed under their outlet by inference and are not counted towards corroboration, so many claims are REQUIRES REVIEW.
findings.fix: Read in full: WRAL's opening-statement story, the Daily Tar Heel's opening story, CBS News's trial story and ABC11's 2021 arrest and 2014 note stories; record full_text access.

findings.message: LR-01: Pending trial: the defendant is presumed innocent. He is never drawn; his name card says 'charged · presumed innocent'; every prosecution point is attributed and paired with the defence's answer; the not-guilty plea is stated in the cold open, chapter 5 and the close.
findings.fix: Keep the same balance in comments and any Shorts.

findings.message: LR-02: The roommate is a State witness and the judge barred the defence from presenting her as an alternative suspect. She is not named in narration, not drawn, and nothing implies suspicion of her; the 2012 'not random' statement and the 2013 profile are attributed to police and the FBI.
findings.fix: Keep.

findings.message: LR-03: Excluded: injury and autopsy detail beyond the cause of death, sexual-assault forensics, the roommate smudge exchange, the roommate's medical history, all uncharged people, the 2016 DNA composite, the jail warrant, and the note's expletive.
findings.fix: Keep them out of packaging and comments.
